utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirtieth. Um, can everyone hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, we've got you. Bit of an echo, but it's all right.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Better than the broken coffee machine in the canteen. That's not making any noise at all. Grim start.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You were cheerful enough at the charity bake sale on Friday. Three brownies, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Two. The other one was structural support for the plate.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office as well, apparently. We're basically running on sponge.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Please tell me it's not another one with someone's face printed on it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, just getting my headset on. Caught the important bit about cake.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, actual factory stuff. I tested the guard switch on two yesterday and it's all fine now. That's closed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That was the one that wasn't making properly?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, that one. Tested and fine, not another job for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the number two bearing yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, I finished the repair on the fire panel last night. Repair's complete.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, the panel repair, rather than the monthly test?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Two separate things. The repair's out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: One observation from nights: noticed the GT1 fuel valve was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, okay. Settled back down, then, not still sitting warm?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, settled. Just passing on what happened, not raising another job off it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mine's still the same blocker. Can't get to the big boiler until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's still blocked, then, not something we're agreeing to get into today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. Nothing changed there.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Stretch Wrapper. Still stuck on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not even a definite delivery confirmation?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nope. Same position as before. Just reporting the blocker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. I'll send the shift handover report round.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Sarah. Easier than trying to piece it together from the chat.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also the training records for the new starters that need sorting. That's a whenever you get a chance one. Anyone able to take it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Um... I can't put my name against that at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, I can't commit to those either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody on the training records, then. Still needs doing, but no owner agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, don't want a vague nod turning into someone's name on it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Priya Raman on the monthly fire alarm test, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And just so the two don't get muddled, that doesn't reopen the repair. That bit's finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Routine monthly test, separate from your repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow at 9:30? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that one tomorrow at 9:30. That time doesn't work for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Priya, can you take that instead? Inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow at 9:30. Same thing: not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's an inspection for leaks we're talking about, yeah? Not a strip-down?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, inspection for leaks. That's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Doesn't need emergency treatment, but that time needs to hold.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya. Sorry for bouncing it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you replace the seals on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Half two today, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I can do that. I'll replace the seals on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there—seals on the valve, not the pump?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The Boiler Safety Relief Valve, yeah. That's my one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, I had those times the wrong way round for a second.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It's Priya on the Boiler Feedwater Pump tomorrow at 9:30, and Han on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve at half two.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, pump tomorrow at 9:30. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And valve seals at half two. We're straight.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. And the training records are still unclaimed. The whenever you get a chance bit isn't an assignment to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep. Nobody's picked those up in here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Well, that was almost as complicated as dividing the office cake into equal slices.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Without coffee, basic arithmetic's beyond me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: We did notice.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a performance review of the canteen, that's us.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cheers, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks all. Bye.
